summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which is hex-name obfuscated (_0x... identifiers, per-call string maps) and downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/... into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB opaque JavaScript bundle protected by string-array shuffling (a WV8StW rotator function over a MmgoCP literal table). The package advertises itself as an ESLint configuration for Node, a role that has no need for a second JavaScript runtime, an obfuscated install-time loader, or a large opaque bundle. The stated purpose is inconsistent with the shipped install behavior, and the obfuscation on both setup.mjs and math_init.js hides what runs under Bun from Node-based scanners. Installing the package causes attacker-selected code to execute on the installer under a runtime the installer did not choose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
